description.zh: 知识块之间重叠的数据大小。此参数的最大值不能大于 ChunkSize 参数的值，默认值为50。
description.en: The number of overlapping characters between adjacent chunks. This value cannot exceed `ChunkSize`. The default is 50.

description.zh: 要切分的知识块大小。默认值为250，最大值为 2048。
description.en: The size of each document chunk. The default is 250, and the maximum is 2,048.

description.zh: 文档加载器的名称，默认采用 ADBPGLoader。
description.en: The name of the document loader. The default is `ADBPGLoader`.
The ID of the knowledge base.

description.zh:
输入文件的OSS Location，格式：
DescribeKnowledgeBaseUploadSignature接口的UploadDir字段值 + 文件名。
description.en: The OSS location of the input file. Construct this path by appending the file name to the `UploadDir` value returned by the `DescribeKnowledgeBaseUploadSignature` operation.

description.zh:
用于分割大量数据的分隔符。
> *   这是一个重要的参数，决定了数据分块的效果。此参数与由TextSplitterName参数指定的分隔器相关。
>*  在大多数情况下，您不需要指定此参数。服务器会根据TextSplitterName参数的值来分配分隔符。
description.en:
An array of strings used to split text.

> - This critical parameter affects data chunking results and is related to the splitter specified by `TextSplitterName`.
>
> - In most cases, you can omit this parameter. The service automatically assigns default separators based on `TextSplitterName`.

description.zh: 切分模型，默认值为 qwen3-8b。
description.en: The splitter model to use. The default is `qwen3-8b`.
The name of the text splitter.

description.zh: 指定是否开启复杂文档的 VL 增强内容识别，默认值为 false。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable visual-linguistic (VL) enhanced content recognition for complex documents. The default is false.

description.zh: 指定是否启用标题增强。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable title enhancement.
